note: This document resolves the name 'latest' to the current schema catalog, as a convenience for people. It is not an immutable protocol identifier: it changes when a new version is published, so never use it as a $id, $schema, or pinned reference. It is a pointer, not a schema: validate against the catalog's resources, each served at its own versioned URL and pinned by digest.

supersedes.note: The superseded single-document schema remains published and unchanged at its own URL. It is not wire-compatible with the current version and must never be coerced into it.
